Donald Trump is systematically placing his name, face, and signature on government buildings, banknotes, and official documents, bypassing the traditional waiting period observed by all previous presidents.

The Poison:
While supporters view this as a bold celebration of leadership, it sets a dangerous precedent where public infrastructure becomes a temporary billboard for whoever holds executive power.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error lies in the Metaphysical plane (WHO). The stated beneficiary is the American public, but the actual beneficiary is strictly Trump's personal brand. It is a classic bait-and-switch of public service for private ego.

Social Physics Analysis:
By using public office to hoard personal power, this campaign creates massive systemic friction. Instead of transparently serving the public, it projects a false narrative of national unity to justify self-aggrandizement.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Destruction.
When you map the gap between public service claims and self-branding results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. This active contraction of democratic norms closes off collaborative futures.

The Unavoidable Truth: No other president has plastered their face on active currency and buildings while in office.
The Unavoidable Lie: This branding is done to honor the office rather than feed an insatiable personal ego.
